lines.text: Many learners say: She gave me many informations.
Better: She gave me a lot of information.

data.right: She gave me a lot of information.

native.tip: “Information” não tem plural em inglês. Use “a lot of information”.
native.caption: Cuidado com este erro comum! 😬 Muita gente diz “She gave me many informations.”. O certo é “She gave me a lot of information.”. Em português é “informações”, mas inglês não aceita o s. Ouça o Carlos e repita! Treine mais no app Lexkite.
native.comment: Resposta: “information”. Treine mais com um quiz grátis aqui: {link}

en.tip: “Information” has no plural in English. Say “a lot of information”.
en.caption: Watch out for this common mistake! Many people say “She gave me many informations.”. The right way is “She gave me a lot of information.”. In Portuguese it is plural, but English does not allow the s. Listen to Carlos and repeat! Practice more in the Lexkite app.
